source: RFC 0014 §3 R1, R2, R6, T (the coordinator's ruling of 2026-11-24 on phase 2 of the cross-version fixture); the red-team inventory, row 19
statement: A route map is not exchanged: each instance reads its own file (cosec.authorization.routes.location) at startup, so two versions meet only through the same file rolled out to both, which they resolve alike.
guards: compat:LocalStateCompatTest#one route map is resolved alike by both versions
